new_libraries.name: AutoPack
new_libraries.author: Aadruta PB <aadrutapb@gmail.com>
new_libraries.sentence: A zero-leak dynamic string unpacker for 8-bit microcontrollers.
new_libraries.paragraph: AutoPack parses variable-length delimited strings in-place and unpacks them directly into native C-style arrays (int, float, byte, char, String) to completely prevent heap fragmentation on SRAM-constrained AVR boards.

new_libraries.name: TimbanganHX711
new_libraries.author: Amadeo Wisesa <wisesaamadeo@gmail.com>
new_libraries.sentence: Timbangan digital berbahasa Indonesia dengan HX711 dan load cell: non-blocking, tara, kalibrasi, deteksi kabel lepas.
new_libraries.paragraph: perbarui() tidak pernah menunggu dan interrupt hanya dimatikan beberapa mikrodetik per pulsa clock, bukan sepanjang pembacaan. Tara dan kalibrasi berjalan di latar belakang; offset dan faktor bisa disimpan ke EEPROM. Melaporkan kabel lepas, data jenuh, dan masa settling dengan pesan berbahasa Indonesia. Gain 128/64 dan kanal B, mode tidur, banyak timbangan sekaligus. Untuk modul HX711, load cell 1-200 kg, YZC-131, sensor berat setengah jembatan. English: HX711 load cell scale weight, non-blocking, tare, calibration, disconnect detection.

library.name: BlueCrypt
library.author: Aadruta PB <aadrutapb@gmail.com>
library.sentence: A lightweight constant-time cryptographic library optimized for 8-bit AVR microcontrollers.
library.paragraph: BlueCrypt V2 features a dynamic 128-slot pipeline scheduler, dual-mode non-linear byte substitution (zero-SRAM Flash PROGMEM or dynamic SRAM), two-pass bidirectional avalanche diffusion, and rolling 2-byte HMAC integrity verification.

library.name: TinyRTOS
library.author: Nikolai Radke
library.sentence: Cooperative task scheduler with resource locks for ATtiny and ATmega AVR MCUs.
library.paragraph: Enables cooperative multitasking on AVR MCUs with as little as 256 bytes of RAM. Compatible with any AVR MCU with up to 128 KB flash. Experimental ATmega2560 support included.
